title: Collectary
tagline: Collectary is an NFT-focused social platform linking users in chat rooms by NFT collection ownership. It uses Chainlink CCIP for secure transfers, fostering a community for NFT enthusiasts.
description:
Collectary stands at the forefront of digital asset interaction, redefining how NFT owners engage within the blockchain space. This innovative social media platform unites individuals based on a shared interest – ownership of NFTs from the same collection. By focusing on this commonality, Collectary fosters a sense of community among users, allowing them to connect and engage in dedicated chat rooms. This feature not only enhances the social aspect of NFT collecting but also enriches the overall user experience by creating a more cohesive and interactive collector community.

Security is paramount in the Collectary ecosystem. To ensure the safe transfer of digital assets, the platform employs the Chainlink Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP), a cutting-edge solution providing robust security and seamless integration for NFT transfers. This implementation of advanced blockchain technology underscores Collectary's commitment to providing a secure, reliable platform for its users.

Currently, Collectary's primary function revolves around its chat room feature. This streamlined focus allows users to engage purely in discussions, sharing insights, and networking within their NFT collection community. The platform's dedication to a chat-centric user experience offers a simple yet effective way for collectors to connect, exchange ideas, and deepen their understanding of the NFT space."

This description highlights the unique aspects of Collectary, emphasizing its community-building features, advanced security measures, and user-focused design.
how_its_made: This project has two major protocols: Chainlink CCIP and Push Protocol. Our aim was to depend on centralized solutions as little as possible, so we wanted to build the social part using Push Protocol's Push Chat service. Push Chat provides a fully decentralized and gasless service for On-Chain messaging. By using it, we are not dependent on any centralized back-end service and handle everything on-chain. There is an admin wallet, and every time a new user signs in, the admin wallet creates a new group chat if there isn't any. By using Chainlink's CCIP, we utilized the cross-chain payment service, and users are able to buy each other's NFTs directly from DM; the chain does not even matter. It was quite hard to merge them into one front-end project, but we were able to overcome this problem and acquire it.
